_readme: Decisions about DS Health findings. This is the ONE file here you edit by hand —
everything else on the DS Health page is generated from the audit.
Its job is to stop the same finding being re-litigated every week. The Stepper case:
the audit flagged a local `Stepper` as shadowing the DS one, but they were unrelated
components that happened to share a word. Without a record of that call, the next
person to see it asks the same question again.
Key format — type:file:name, never a line number, because lines move:
align    the DS already covers this; the screen should use the real component
promote  a genuine gap; becomes a new DS component or a variant of an existing one
accepted a false positive, or a deliberate exception. It stays as it is.
Every entry needs a `why`. A verdict with no reasoning is how the next person ends up
reversing a decision that was right.

possible-card-reimpl:src/screens/PeopleA.note: False positive, and the cause is exact: the check looks for the word "children" in a function's first five lines to decide it takes a children prop. StudioPermissionsView's fifth line reads `granted.flatMap(n => [n, ...(n.children ?? [])])` — that is the permission tree's own data shape, not React children. The component takes { studioId, onBack } and renders a whole view: a back button, a header row, a stats strip and the permission tree. The two divs inside it that WERE card-shaped are CardContainer now.

raw-button:src/screens/pm-lex-playbooks/.note: The wizard's 8-step pill nav (line 544) is a real <button> per-step, each combining a numbered index, a label, and — on one step — an inline Tag sub-badge. SwitchTab is documented for 2-7 items and has no slot for a per-item sub-badge, so it doesn't fit 8 steps with a badge on one of them. This is a deliberate DS-GAP (flagged inline in the code) rather than a Button being avoided out of convenience — a Button here would need variant/size semantics that don't match a step pill. Flagging for @cachilupis to confirm or override; revisit if SwitchTab ever grows an item cap increase or a badge slot.

hand-rolled-avatar:src/screens/pm-lex-pl.note: False positive — the check matches any 16-64px circle at 50% radius, but PhaseCard's circle (line 181) is a numbered step index ('1', '2', ...), not a person. AvatarCircle sizes initials and hashes a colour from a person's name; there is no person here to represent, so AvatarCircle doesn't fit. This surfaced only after moving config-sections/ under src/screens/pm-lex-playbooks/, which is the first time this check ran against the file.

Same false positive as the BuilderWizard/PhasesActionsSection case: an 18px numbered circle (line 144) in the redesigned 'Executes Through N Sequential Phases' panel is a phase index ('1', '2', ...), not a person avatar. AvatarCircle doesn't apply — there's nobody to represent.
